primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: EBC is a method used to investigate cerebellar-dependent learning. In EBC, a conditioned stimulus, a tone precedes but co-terminates with an unconditioned stimulus, an airpuff to the eyelid. Learning is demonstrated when an eyeblink (the conditioned response) occurs prior to the onset of the unconditioned stimulus. The percentage can range from 0% (no conditioned learning has occurred) to 100% (all responses are conditioned). Results are reported as least squares (LS) means at Day 8, determined using an analysis of variance (ANOVA).

groups.description: Participants received luvadaxistat 50 mg orally QD for 8 days during either treatment periods 1 or 2 of the study.

groups.description: Participants received matching placebo orally QD for 8 days during either treatment periods 1 or 2 of the study. groups.title: Placebo (Reference for Luvadaxistat 50 mg)
